date_note: Date of Soft99's own notice (10 November 2026, 16:00); Security NEXT reported it on 20 November. The contractor alerted Soft99 on 5 November and the company reported to the Personal Information Protection Commission on 9 November.
title: Soft99: unauthorized file on online shop, personal data of up to 136,968 customers may have leaked
summary: Soft99 said on 10 November that an outside party uploaded a program file through the image-attachment function of its online shop's inquiry form; a contractor alerted it on 5 November. Personal information of up to 136,968 people, including names, addresses, birth dates, purchase history and partial card data, may have leaked. The shop was suspended and the cause is under investigation.
plain: Japanese car-care company Soft99 says a hacker's file was found on its online shop and data of up to 136,968 customers may have leaked.
exec: A retailer's web shop was compromised, putting up to 136,968 customers' personal data at risk.
action: Soft99 customers: watch for phishing that uses your name or purchase details, and check card statements for unfamiliar charges.

validation.note: Primary source: Soft99's own notice of 10 November 2026 (read by the follow-up run on 22 November) states the 5 November contractor alert, the upload through the inquiry form's image-attachment function, up to 136,968 people, the data items, the shop suspension and the 9 November report to the Personal Information Protection Commission; Security NEXT relays it. Soft99's notices page also lists a separate 17 November notice about unauthorized access at an outsourcing company; it was not read and is not part of this record.
